_comment: Most cases are the real batch the first scheduled run collected on 2026-09-16 (issue #41):
the headline and the excerpt exactly as the collector normalized them, which is all the
review queue ever stores of a source (a link, a title and a <=500-character excerpt).
The `tr-*` and `borderline-*` cases are synthetic, written to cover Turkish spellings and
the uncertainty band, which the English UN feeds do not exercise on their own.
`expect` is `queued` or `off-topic`; `region` is the region guess the filter must produce,
`null` when the item names no watch region at all.

cases.title: Houthi Advance towards Key Red Sea Chokepoint Raises Risk of Wider Conflict, Assistant Secretary-General Warns
cases.text: International efforts are urgently needed to prevent further escalation of the conflict in Yemen and safeguard freedom of navigation in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, the Security Council heard today in an emergency meeting following recent Houthi advances towards the critical global chokepoint.

cases.title: Security Council, 10222nd Meeting (PM) Yemen
cases.text: The Security Council will meet at 3 p.m. today on the Middle East amid growing concern over the Houthis’ advance along Yemen’s Red Sea coast. The group seized the port of Mokha and Mayyun Island last week and reportedly moved onto the Greater and Lesser Hanish islands, tightening its grip on the…

cases.title: Escalating conflict drives new displacement in Yemen
cases.text: The escalating conflict in Yemen is choking off aid shipments and driving fresh displacement, including to nearby Djibouti, with UN agencies reporting on Tuesday that nearly 100,000 people have been displaced since fighting intensified earlier this month.

cases.title: Civilians bear the brunt, with deadly US strikes in Iran and thousands displaced in Yemen
cases.text: Independent UN human rights investigators called for an immediate cessation of hostilities on Monday following a series of United States airstrikes on Iran in recent weeks that have killed civilians as tensions ripple through the region.

cases.title: Six UN staff killed in Gaza school strike; Lebanon violations mount
cases.text: Israeli strikes killed six UN workers and civilians at a school sheltering displaced families in Gaza as needs grow, according to the UN agency for Palestine refugees, UNRWA.

cases.title: Ukraine: Drone attacks on Chornobyl are ‘gambling with the safety of millions of people’
cases.text: A drone strike on the protective structure at the Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant could have endangered the safety of millions of people, UN Development Programme (UNDP) Administrator Alexander De Croo told reporters via video link from Kyiv on Thursday.

cases.text: Two years ago, the idea of a large-scale war breaking out felt like a distant hypothetical to the experts who help chart the world’s dangers. Today it tops their list of fears, according to a new UN Global Risk Report.
